notes.title: 1.1.0 Global Leaderboards
notes.content:
[h1]Global Leaderboards[/h1]

The Arcade Mode now has a global leaderboards where you can compare your best score with other players.

[h1]Improvements and Fixes[/h1]

Last month I took Super Dash to Jogatório, an indie game event here in Brazil. There I saw around 100 players interacting with the game and got a lot of feedback and new ideas on how to make it better.

All changes in this version were made with their help so if you were there thank you for playing the game!

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]

- The initial tutorial was restructured to be easier to understand. It has more text but the game only has that amount of text in this section.
- You'll see a popup to play the Advanced Tutorial once, there you can learn more mechanics about the game and hopefully get to higher waves
- Unecessary tutorial popups were removed to make the game more dynamic

[h2]Bosses[/h2]

- The first 4 bosses were updated and rebalanced
- The teleporter boss is less annoying now and has a bigger window before it teleports
- The shooter boos has a different visual that shows where he'll shoot next and when he can receive damage

[h2]Controllers[/h2]

- The aiming is different with a controller now, it doesn't flick to the opposite direction if you stop aiming before a dash
- You can adjust sensibility in the settings
- The default "stop dash" button is now the right shoulder (R1, RB)

[h2]Others[/h2]

- when you revive enemies around you get destroyed
- the shield is easier to see now and stays for more time before breaking
- complicated power ups don't appear in initial waves
- the UI for some health challenges is better now and you can see how much time its left
- fixing some typos

notes.title: 1.0.8 New SFXs
notes.content:
Phelippe just made some new sfx for the game that make it juicierrr, they're for bosses and gameplay in general:

- sonar sound for the last enemy destroyed in every wave
- shield boss laser
- and a lot of new sfxs for the last super boss


Also fixing a bug that would remove infinite lives in Zen Mode, thanks Aergis for reporting that.

notes.title: 1.0.7 Localization
notes.content:
The game now can be played in:
[list]
[*] Spanish
[*] Italian
[*] French
[*] Russian
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Chinese Traditional
[*] Chinese Simplified
[/list]

New Features/Improvements:
When connecting a gamepad the new input mode will be the new gamepad
The analog aim now moves smoothly instead of teleporting

Thanks Delboni for testing with a gamepad <3

Bug Fixes:
Spawner enemies are not super fast anymore (Thanks, snoopcri)
Fixed an startup bug that was preventing new players from starting the game
Fixed a but where you'd get infinite Boss Emblems if buying PU too quickly 😦 (Thanks, Marcus for getting this)
Fixed some mouse glyphs that were not showing up

notes.title: 1.0.4 - Controller Support
notes.content:
New Features/Improvements:
[list]
[*] Super Dash now has support for a variety of controllers, not just the DualSense.
[*] You can now see your current power-ups when selecting a new one.
[*] Fixed some PT-BR localization issues.
[*] Added new popups explaining yellow shield enemies and red projectiles.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an error when selecting the Wormhole (Level 2). (Thanks, Fausto!)
[*] Fixed an issue in Arcade/Zen mode where the game would get stuck. (Thanks, Rubens!)
[*] Fixed menu slide animations getting stuck when alt-tabbing. (Thanks, Biel and friends!)
[*] Fixed a crash when selecting a 3-wave challenge. (Also thanks to Biel 'n' friends and Flávio!)
[*] Fixed credits display on ultrawide screens.
[/list]

A lot of people have been helping me make the game better, and I'm really grateful for that! <3

- super boss from run 2 now spawns nuke items so the player can destroy all enemies on the map
- fix bug where Marcão got stuck while fighting the Bouncer Boss
- balance first boss fight and run 2 spawn rate

Added a new game mode, "Zen Mode", that has infinite lives and its more chill with fewer enemies on screen. It doesn't store the highscore as the Arcade Mode but still is a good way to enjoy the diversity of power ups and enemies as well as practive for the other modes.

Also fixing a bug that wasn't unlocking achievements on Steam. Achievements unlocked in the meantime will be activated all at once when the game loads again.
